import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
i=G['Demo pair 3 input']; o=G['Demo pair 3 output']
diff=[(r,c,i[r][c],o[r][c]) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
print('added 3 cells:', sorted(diff))
# summary of what was added per line
rows_c=[]
for r,c,a,b in diff:
    rows_c.append((r,c))
rs=sorted({r for r,c in rows_c}); cs=sorted({c for r,c in rows_c})
print('rows touched',rs,'cols touched',cs)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    i=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])

    threes=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r][c]==3]
    add=[(r,c,o[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r][c]!=o[r][c]]

    print(' 2s',twos,'3s',threes)
    # summarize added cells as lines
    import collections
    bycol=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,_ in add: bycol[c].append(r)
    for c,rs in sorted(bycol.items()):
        cont=all(b-a==1 for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:])) if len(rs)>1 else True
        print(f'  col{c} rows{rs[0]}-{rs[-1]} contiguous={cont} n={len(rs)}')

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

        for di,dj in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj

            key=(ni,nj)

                dist[key]=(dist.get(c,tuple()) if False else None)
                par[key]=c;dist[key]=None

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import deque
    bg=None
    # identify bg: color that is most common excluding 2 and 3? just most common overall
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    twos=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==2]
    threes=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==3]
    par={};seen=set(twos);dq=deque()
    for t in twos: dq.append(t)
    while dq:
        c=dq.popleft();i,j=c
        if g[i][j]==3: break
        for di,dj in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
            if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and g[ni][nj] in (bg,2,3) and (ni,nj) not in seen:
                seen.add((ni,nj));par[(ni,nj)]=c;dq.append((ni,nj))
    p=None
    for i,j in threes:
        for di,dj in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            if (i+di,j+dj) in seen: p=(i+di,j+dj);break
        if p: break
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    while par.get(p):
        out[p[0]][p[1]]=3;p=par[p]
    return out,p
